gaia_catalog.query: SELECT source_id, ref_epoch, ra, dec, parallax, pmra, pmdec, ra_error, dec_error, parallax_error, pmra_error, pmdec_error, ra_dec_corr, ra_parallax_corr, ra_pmra_corr, ra_pmdec_corr, dec_parallax_corr, dec_pmra_corr, dec_pmdec_corr, parallax_pmra_corr, parallax_pmdec_corr, pmra_pmdec_corr, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved, visibility_periods_used, duplicated_source, ipd_frac_multi_peak, non_single_star, phot_variable_flag FROM gaia_dr3_source WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',133.76037473328523,-7.242149767967145,0.25))=1 AND phot_g_mean_mag < 18.5 ORDER BY source_id

configurations.snr_note: Aperture statistic conditional on fitted position; best individual comparison uses the coadd mask. Not a blind detection significance or total flux measurement.
configurations.uncertainty_note: Conditional centroid noise + calibration covariance + conservative second-moment heldout term; not a discovery probability or full systematic-error budget.

calibration_bootstrap.note: Paired resampling of training sources; one correlated Gaia 5-parameter draw per source shared across all epochs. Positive covariance envelope with the formal independent-exposure estimate. Conditional on measured centroids and ePSF.

limitations: Gaia also contributes to the SPHEREx input WCS: heldout means excluded from this local fit, not independent of the mission calibration.
Catalog-quality and signal cuts select brighter isolated stars; infrared-only blends can remain.
Five-parameter first-order propagation with Earth observer; perspective and Gaia global systematics are not modeled.
Calibration covariance is conditional on fixed ePSFs and measured reference centroids; heldout floor is a conservative second moment with only seven stars.
Two target epochs cannot separate proper motion and parallax; broad/strict configurations share exposures.
Optical Gaia and infrared photocentres can differ with colour or unresolved neighbours; the reference-star floor need not describe this very red target.
